newsitem.title: USA: New staff director for US Senate Ag Committee.
newsitem.headline: New staff director for US Senate Ag Committee.

text.p: Senate Agriculture Committee chairman Richard Lugar said on Wednesday that Randy Green was the new staff director for the committee.

Green, who was a deputy agriculture undersecretary in the administration of former President George Bush, succeeds Chuck Connor, who will become president of the Corn Refiners Association, an industry group.
Since 1993, Green has been Lugar's senior policy aide on the committee. He also worked for the committee from 1989-91.
Connor spent 17 years on the Indiana Republican Senator's staff, including 10 years as his top aide on the committee.
